## Four more features shipped & verified against the real backend (4/4)

- **Path Highlight on the neighborhood**: Impact-paths now renders the endpoints' full neighborhood and **highlights** the traced path (brightened nodes + cyan path edges) while **dimming** the surrounding context — done imperatively on the Sigma canvas. Switching back to Explore clears it.
- **Evidence Pinning**: every evidence snippet in Ask has a pin button; pinned items collect in a right-side **"Evidence board"** drawer (top-bar count badge) with Copy, Export-JSON, remove, and Clear — for building a case.
- **Source Onboarding**: a guided 3-step wizard launched from any connector card in the Ingestion Console — register the source (`POST /sources`) then kick off a **baseline ingestion** (`POST /sources/{id}/baseline`) and see the resulting job. URL-type connectors now require a base URL up front (fixes the 422 the tester caught).
- **View Sharing**: saved graph views can be **exported to JSON and imported** back, so teammates can open the same picture.

All wired to real `/api/v1/*` data, TypeScript-strict clean, services healthy. Note: AI narration remains labeled **SIMULATED** since no inference model is enabled in this deployment (local-first).

- Next Action Items:
  - **Path Compare**: Let users trace paths to two different targets and compare the blast surfaces side by side
  - **Case Export**: Turn the pinned Evidence board into a shareable report with the question, answer and citations
  - **Source Health**: Show live health and last-run status for each registered source with a one-click re-sync
  - **View Thumbnails**: Give each saved graph view a small preview image so they're easy to recognise
